notes.title: Notice Regarding the Next Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support.



[strike]The preparations for the next update are complete. However, due to Steam’s security protocols, the release on the official branch (default) may be delayed by up to 72 hours.[/strike]



[strike]During this period, you can try the new version early via the beta branch.[/strike]

[strike]To join the beta branch, go to your Library → Right-click the game → Properties → “Betas” tab, and select “public_beta.”For details on the update, please see the “Update History” section in the Community Hub.[/strike]



[strike]We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience until the update is fully released.[/strike]



The update has been applied to the official release, so you can now play from the official version.

Thank you for continuing to support “Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!”
